verdict.rationale: HMRC's own GOV.UK pages state that its core transactions can be done online: employer registration ("Most limited companies can register online"), VAT registration and exemption requests via the "register for VAT online service", Making Tax Digital sign-up via an online service, and Corporation Tax managed online through the business tax account. Income Tax filing under Making Tax Digital runs through third-party compatible software rather than an HMRC-hosted form. missing for 10: evidence that tax payment can be completed online, independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a transaction end-to-end, and coverage beyond "most" limited companies for employer registration.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: Most limited companies can register online.
Apply for an exemption from registration either: online using the register for VAT online service
If you're a sole trader or landlord, use the online service to sign up for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.
You will then be able to manage your Corporation Tax online.
